scope: architecture decision on main; offline implementation already present; no live activation

invariants.gate_rule: R_bps >= 48.0 AND R_price > C_price at decision and dispatch
invariants.tested_cost_rule: C_price = median_spread + round_trip_commission + 2 * 24/10000 * reference_price; enter only when C_price < R_price
invariants.interpretation: 48 bps is the owner-selected minimum, not a replacement for spread, commission or strict cost admission
invariants.breakeven_basis: gross entry-price stop; costs and gaps can make the exit net-negative
invariants.stop_amendment: executable quote triggers; effective only on a strictly later valid quote; original bracket has priority
invariants.target_basis: gross whole-position target, rounded outward to price grid
invariants.cost_calibration: research assumption; not an empirically calibrated broker estimate
invariants.goal: 73% net wins and reference risk:reward 1:1.38 over latest 20 closed trades for each strategy/account; 15/20 = 75%

peer_status.scope: authorised macro research peer confirmation; no new production cross-asset filter

empirical_observation.profit_factor_basis: normalised R, not pooled account dollars

without_this_protocol_flag.caveat: Descriptive subset only; original rows retained; other quote/preparation limitations remain.

empirical_observation.qualification: exploratory development result; not validation or proof of a consistent edge

next_stage.sampling: freeze representative dates, symbol coverage, costs, cohort/job budget and stopping rule before observing new outcomes
next_stage.milestone_caveat: 20 pooled research closes do not establish the per-strategy/account goal; no outcome-driven sampling until enough wins
next_stage.source_control: exclude spent intervals from new evaluation, retain failures/censoring, do not recollect under new job names
